_comment: Hand edits on top of the OpenStreetMap draft (scripts/stations/draft_from_osm.py), from the research pass of 2026-10-30 (data/stations/research/fi_KV).

changelog.what: First draft from OSM with the research pass's platform numbers, entrances, heights and amenities.

Platform heights from Digitraffic infra-api platforms (Fintraffic/Väylävirasto, CC BY 4.0); 1 buildings, roofs and footbridges with laser heights; the ground as a 5 m grid (3D research pass, data/stations/research/fi_KV).

structures.name: roof
structures._source: Outline OSM w150348628 (ODbL); roof = median of 5 unclassified laser points >2 m above the terrain model inside the outline; Laserkeilausaineisto 0,5 p, newest per sheet (clack_fi_mml05_L4443D2), Maanmittauslaitos (National Land Survey of Finland), CC BY 4.0; scanned L4443D2 2025-08-02 (20250001_MML_Kouvola_kesa_LAATUPOIKKEAMIA); from data/stations/research/fi_KV/kouvola_structures_heights.geojson (metres above the platform surface, 72.36 m RH 2000, laser 2025-08-02); underside not measured

terrain._source: ground from the laser's ground points, 1 m (data/stations/research/fi_KV/kouvola_ground_1m.tif), sampled every 5 m; Laserkeilausaineisto 0,5 p, © Maanmittauslaitos, CC BY 4.0. Heights above the platform surface (72.36 m N2000, laser 2025-08-02)
